ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show fee to the rider's original payment method; no penalty on the driver
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the complaint, the driver's statement and the (empty) chat contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; dispute type is no_show, not safety. Safety concern: none.

The driver cancelled and the app reason was rider_no_show [F4], so the charge stands only if every NS-1 condition holds.

(i) Arrival: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 09:53:15, 40 m from the pickup point, and GPS puts him within 200 m from 09:52:40 onward [F1][F2][F6][F7] — met.
(ii) Free wait: the driver first came within 200 m at 09:52:40 and arrived at 09:53:15; cancellation was at 09:59:45, i.e. 6 min 30 s after arrival and 7 min 5 s within 200 m [F2][F3][F6]. The 5-minute free wait had passed — met (no record no-show threshold applies here).
(iii) Contact attempt: before cancelling the driver sent 0 in-app messages and made 0 in-app calls [F5]; the chat log is empty [F10]. NS-1(iii) requires at least one in-app message AND at least one in-app call — NOT met. The driver's post-trip assertion that he waited is a claim, and it does not supply the missing contact attempts [F11].
(iv) Continuous presence: stationary within 200 m from 09:53:15 to 09:59:45 [F3][F7] — met.

Because NS-1(iii) fails, the $5.00 fee is voided under NS-2 and must be refunded in full: amount $5.00 [F4][F8]. No surge is involved [F9]; no traffic findings bear on this case [F12][F13]. The profiles [F15][F16] show no fraud flag and no repeat no-shows, so no account flag is warranted; the rider's own no-show history is nil, and a driver-side account flag (NS-2 / RD-6) is not triggered by merely failing a contact condition. Refund is under $10 and is final at system level (TH-1/TH-2).

element_findings.element: Driver arrived at pickup within 200 m with arrival confirmation
element_findings.reason: Tapped 'I'm Here' at 09:53:15, 40 m from pickup; within 200 m from 09:52:40. NS-1(i).
Cancelled 09:59:45, 6 min 30 s after arrival and 7 min 5 s within 200 m. NS-1(ii).

element_findings.element: Driver sent ≥1 in-app message AND made ≥1 in-app call before cancelling
element_findings.reason: 0 messages and 0 calls before cancellation; chat log empty. NS-1(iii).

element_findings.element: Driver stayed at pickup point throughout
element_findings.reason: Stationary within 200 m from 09:53:15 to 09:59:45. NS-1(iv).
App reason rider_no_show and driver's statement both cite rider no-show; NS-1/NS-2 apply via NS-0.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's post-trip statement asserts a valid no-show cancellation, but the system records show zero in-app messages and zero in-app calls before cancellation, so NS-1(iii) fails and the claim does not save the fee.
